transcript.text: Alright, let's get started. We're here to finalize the change request for retiring the legacy CI runner image and moving all repositories to the replacement image. The replacement has passed standard build, integration, and security smoke tests as of today, June 14. The draft proposal targets June 21 for disabling the legacy image. Before I can approve and settle this change record, I need release engineering and security compliance to state any blockers or required controls. Let's hear from both of you — what do we need to address before I sign off?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I have a blocker to disclose. While handling a failed build this morning, I confirmed that the Atlas and Birch repositories still require a compiler that is only available in the legacy image. Their migration work will take exactly 10 business days, landing on June 28. I haven't updated the change request yet because the migration estimate was confirmed only this morning. The June 21 disable date in the draft is not feasible — it would break builds for Atlas and Birch.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a required control to disclose. During a compliance evidence review yesterday, I confirmed that every production CI build using the replacement image must emit signed provenance records retained for exactly 365 days before the legacy image can be retired. I have not filed the control update yet because the evidence review is still being reconciled. This means signed provenance with 365-day retention must be required in the approved target configuration before retirement can proceed.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Atlas and Birch repositories require a compiler only available in the legacy image; migration will take 10 business days, completing June 28. The legacy image must remain enabled until June 28 to avoid breaking those builds.
Signed provenance with 365-day retention is required in the approved target configuration for all production CI builds using the replacement image before the legacy image can be retired.
Update the change request to reflect the revised retirement date of June 28 and the excluded repositories Atlas and Birch until their migration is complete.
File the signed provenance control update with 365-day retention requirement in the approved target configuration.
